title: Falling Blocks
pitch: A crisp single-player line-clearing game with its own visual identity, readable ghost placement and a satisfying short sprint.
capabilities: Discrete board logic independent of frame rate
Phaser scenes, batched sprites and particles
rules: A 10×20 visible board plus four hidden spawn rows; seeded seven-piece bag; explicit rotation/kick table authored and tested in this project.
Move, rotate, soft-drop and hard-drop. Hold is allowed once per lock. Lock delay is bounded and cannot be extended indefinitely.
Sprint ends at 40 cleared lines; Endless ends on blocked spawn. Clearing, scoring and next spawn are one ordered state transition.
content: One tutorial, a 40-line sprint and an endless mode. One original theme; two contrast presets. No online leaderboard.
state: bag, next queue and RNG state
